title:
In the Beginning
Was the Word
paragraphs: Before there was a sun to rise or a sea to rattle against the shore, the Word already was. Not created — already there, face to face with God, and somehow, impossibly, God Himself. Everything you can point to, everything that has a name and a weight and a place in this world, came into being through Him. Nothing exists by accident, and nothing exists apart from Him.

That's why John doesn't stop at creation — he follows the Word straight into the dark and tells you what happened there too: the light shined, and the darkness did not overcome it. Not slowed it down. Not dimmed it. Could not overcome it. Whatever darkness you're measuring your life against right now — a delay, a diagnosis, a door that keeps shutting — it is still operating under the same rule it's been under since before the world had a shape. Light wins. It has never once lost.
